name: Hotel de Berri Champs-Elysees
insider_take: This intimate Luxury Collection gem puts you in the heart of Paris's Golden Triangle, where haute couture meets Haussmann elegance just steps from the Champs-Élysées.
whats_special: Hotel de Berri occupies a beautifully restored 1930s Haussmann building that once housed the legendary Crazy Horse cabaret. The property features only 74 rooms and suites, creating an exclusive boutique atmosphere rare for this coveted location. Its position on Rue de Berri places you within the prestigious 8th arrondissement's "Golden Triangle" - bounded by the Champs-Élysées, Avenue Montaigne, and Avenue George V.
pro_tip: Book a suite facing the interior courtyard for ultimate tranquility, or request a high floor room for glimpses of the Arc de Triomphe. The hotel's concierge can secure same-day reservations at Michelin-starred restaurants that are typically booked months in advance.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime location means luxury flagship stores like Louis Vuitton, Cartier, and Hermès are literally around the corner on Avenue Montaigne. The Arc de Triomphe is a 5-minute stroll away, while the hidden Parc Monceau - Paris's most elegant park favored by locals - is just 10 minutes north. For culture enthusiasts, both the Grand Palais and Petit Palais are within easy walking distance.
pros: Prime Champs-Elysees location steps from luxury shopping
Elegant Parisian boutique hotel with sophisticated design
Marriott STARS Program exclusive benefits and amenities
Intimate luxury experience with personalized service
cons: Boutique size with limited facilities compared to larger hotels
Premium pricing typical of Champs-Elysees luxury properties
